name: Oracle
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: High Religion, high mystery skill, moderate or high skill themed to deity; high Cha; low AC; low Fortitude, high Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Spontaneous divine spellcasting as an oracle of their level; oracle mystery and related spells, revelation spells, curse, skill, and oracle feats

notes.skills: High Religion, a high mystery skill, and a moderate or high skill themed to the deity.
notes.defense: Low AC; low Fortitude, high Will; low to moderate HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Spontaneous divine spellcasting as an oracle of its level: {maxrank}. Mystery and related spells, revelation spells.
notes.specials: Oracle mystery, curse, skill, and oracle feats.
